Title: Research through Design (RtD)
Description: Explored generative design spaces and tangible user interactions through physical prototyping and research-through-design methodology within the MSc IPD curriculum.
Tags: Research through Design;TU Delft;Design Research;Interaction;Physical Prototyping

Title: Klimmende Stapelaar
Description: Engineered and prototyped a climbing stacker mechanism during the Mechanical Engineering BSc at TU Delft, focusing on kinematics, stress analysis, and functional validation.

Title: Custom Mini Vehicle
Description: Designed and fabricated a miniature vehicle prototype from scratch, engineering the custom chassis, gearing ratio, and steering assembly for stability and efficiency.

Title: Direct Air Carbon Capture Paper
Description: Conducted a research study and thermodynamic feasibility analysis on a mechanical Direct Air Capture (DAC) machine for carbon mitigation, modeling scalability and energy demands.

Title: Mini CNC Machine
Description: Designed and assembled a functional 3-axis desktop CNC machine, integrating precision linear rails, stepper motor motion control, and custom structural brackets.

Title: Baxter Roll
Description: Developed a considered product concept through research, mechanical development, prototyping, and iteration with a focus on how the final experience should feel to use.

Title: Hyperion Lyceum
Description: Completed pre-university education (VWO) at Hyperion Lyceum in Amsterdam with a strong focus on mathematics, natural sciences, and analytical philosophy as preparation for TU Delft.

Title: Offshore Workability Analysis
Short description: Feasibility studies for offshore access operations.
Description: Analyse weather data, vessel specifications, and operational limits at Ampelmann to assess whether planned motion-compensated walk-to-work operations are viable before they go to sea.

Title: High School STEM Tutoring
Description: Provided 1-on-1 tutoring and exam preparation for secondary school students in mathematics, physics, and chemistry (wiskunde & natuurkunde), translating complex concepts into intuitive methods.

Title: Platenmeubel (Vinyl Cabinet)
Description: Designed and hand-crafted a bespoke wooden cabinet tailored for vinyl records and turntable setup, prioritizing clean joinery, acoustic decoupling, and warmth.

Title: Ergonomic Laptop Stand
Description: Designed and fabricated an elevated laptop stand focused on ergonomic posture, passive thermal airflow, and clean tactile aesthetics for everyday desk use.

Title: Photography
Short description: Stills shaped by light, texture, and overlooked moments.
Description: Photographing with whatever is to hand and looking for the in-between moments that do not ask to be noticed. The work is led by atmosphere, composition, and natural light.

Title: Writing & Production
Short description: Instrumental music focused on texture and space.
Description: Writing and producing mostly instrumental music with an interest in texture, space, and ideas that take a moment to resolve.
